title: Training Camps
subtitle: The different, individual and unique training camp
intro: We design your training camp to measure: we analyse your previous training and create the perfect plan for your goals. Unforgettable weeks in Lanzarote, with pleasant temperatures all year round. Now also in a HYROX version, with sessions at our box.
advantages: Dates and length of your choice (subject to accommodation availability)
Sessions focused on your goals and weaknesses
No mixed-level groups: you're never held back or left behind
Personal training: all the focus is on you
A whole apartment instead of a hotel room (your family can come too)
Island life away from mass tourism
Secret spots and the best of the island
included: Lactate test at the start of the camp to set your zones
Accommodation in a fully equipped apartment (up to 6 people)
Personal training sessions: guided bike rides, running, swimming and running technique analysis — or HYROX sessions at the box
pricesNote: Price per person with all services included. Other durations and companions on request.

extras.title: Food package
extras.text: Individual nutrition plan adapted to your training and grocery shopping. Quick and easy recipes… you do the cooking!

extras.title: 4-week preparation plan
extras.text: A plan to arrive at the camp in shape, with an initial interview and analysis of your training.

extras.title: Rental bike
extras.text: We arrange a rental triathlon or road bike, with transport included, at no handling cost.
